capabilities.text: Enter notes into the bedside clinical system (CareVue)
capabilities.quote: On a typical shift, a nurse starts by opening CareVue on the bedside terminal, logs in with their badge, and selects the patient’s chart.

capabilities.text: Review and confirm notes before sending to Epic
capabilities.quote: Got it: the nurse reviews and confirms before anything reaches Epic.

capabilities.text: Send notes to the hospital's central EHR (Epic)
capabilities.quote: must also appear in the hospital’s main EHR, which is called Epic.

capabilities.text: Grant access to charge nurses, clinical leads, and ward managers
capabilities.quote: So access should be granted to charge nurses, clinical leads, and ward managers—not just the original nurse.

capabilities.text: Use a low-code integration platform
capabilities.quote: let’s go with a solution that uses a low-code integration platform

capabilities.text: Use pre-built connectors for CareVue and Epic
capabilities.quote: with pre-built connectors for CareVue and Epic, so the team can focus on workflow logic

capabilities.text: Run a test version in a sandbox before going live
capabilities.quote: I’d want to see a test version running in a sandbox first, so we can check the flow

capabilities.text: Go live by the end of next quarter (around September 30)
capabilities.quote: We need version one live by the end of next quarter—around September 30

capabilities.text: Focus version one on the core workflow (enter, review, send to Epic)
capabilities.quote: we’ll focus version one on just the core workflow: entering a note in CareVue, reviewing it, and sending it to Epic

capabilities.text: Stay within a budget of approximately $25,000 for workflow improvements
capabilities.quote: we’ve allocated about $25,000 for workflow improvements this quarter, and this project is part of that.

capabilities.text: Provide a clear breakdown of costs (licensing, integration, training) if near budget limit
capabilities.quote: I’d want a clear breakdown of where every dollar goes—especially for licensing, integration, and training

capabilities.text: Support approximately 100 users at launch (80 nurses, charge nurses, clinical leads)
capabilities.quote: it will be used by about 80 nurses across the three main wards, plus the charge nurses and clinical leads—around 100 total users

capabilities.text: Test with at least 20 nurses in the sandbox before going live
capabilities.quote: I’d still want to test with at least 20 nurses in the sandbox before going live

capabilities.text: Include at least one nurse tester from each of the three wards
capabilities.quote: I’d want those 20 testers to include at least one nurse from each of the three wards

capabilities.text: Time new process during sandbox testing for comparison
capabilities.quote: We’ll also ask them to time how long the new process takes so we can compare it to the old double-entry method.

capabilities.text: Comply with HIPAA regulations
capabilities.quote: they’re definitely subject to HIPAA, since we’re in the U.S. and this is protected health information.

capabilities.text: Log every access and change
capabilities.quote: I’d want the system to log every access and change

capabilities.text: Encrypt data in transit and at rest
capabilities.quote: and ensure data is encrypted both in transit and at rest.

capabilities.text: Retain logs for at least six years
capabilities.quote: I’d want the logs to be retained for at least six years, in line with our hospital’s recordkeeping policy.

capabilities.text: Inbound data flow from CareVue
capabilities.quote: notes flow inbound from CareVue

capabilities.text: Use CareVue vendor's standard secure login for connection
capabilities.quote: the connection uses the vendor’s standard secure login.

capabilities.text: Rotate login credentials every 90 days
capabilities.quote: I’d just want to confirm that the login credentials are rotated every 90 days, as per hospital policy.

capabilities.text: See a clear success message after confirming a note
capabilities.quote: the nurse needs to be able to see a clear success message, know the note is now in Epic

capabilities.text: See a clear error message if Epic fails to save the note
capabilities.quote: If Epic fails to save the note, the nurse needs to see a clear error message that says what went wrong
